reasons: Aggregation differs: Datadog uses avg by docker_image, but the candidate uses sum by container_image_name, which changes the value whenever a group has more than one series.
Quantity differs: the Datadog query has no .as_rate() or .as_count(), so it shows the raw bytes value. The candidate applies rate(), which yields bytes per second, a different quantity and unit.
Grouping is equivalent: docker_image maps to container_image_name, which is an observed dataset label.
The operation="read" matcher and the summing over device_major/device_minor are reasonable, but they do not fix the aggregation and quantity mismatches.
Scope template variable $scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
